scope: native per-CPU STOP request, acknowledgement and teardown ownership

observed_transport.master_queue: 56-byte packets consumed only by guest CPU0
observed_transport.regular_queue: 128-byte IkcScdPacket per-CPU channels are the only existing per-rank delivery route

blocking_prerequisites: independently retained parking storage and a terminal CPU transition before reclaiming guest code, stack or page tables
deferred stop after packet release and interrupted-context rundown; the packet handler itself cannot park
per-generation inventory and drain for guest-allocated Linux IRQ-work nodes, including publication followed by failed IPI
a started BootIrqRoute unpublish and callback-drain path before slot generation reuse
immutable boot-session identity and explicit STOP capability established before ordinary service admission

provisional_encoding_not_reserved.fields: MSTP magic, version/length, OS slot, guest CPU rank, OS generation, stop sequence, 16-byte boot session, channel cookie, phase, zero reserved bytes
provisional_encoding_not_reserved.route: port 501 request per assigned CPU; port 503 ACK echoing exact identity tuple

failure_rule: timeout or any stale/malformed/missing ACK retains CPU assignments, RAM, mappings, queues, module pins and request ledger
